title.zh: 将伊洛伊洛省哈尼瓦伊市镇卡纳维利描笼涯Canauili描笼涯中学的名称变更为Manuel A. Aaron纪念描笼涯中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Canauili Barangay High School in Barangay Canauili, Municipality of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo, To Manuel A. Aaron Memorial Barangay High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Canauili Barangay High School in Barangay Canauili, Municipality of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo, To Manuel A. Aaron Memorial Barangay High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Canauili Barangay tại Barangay Canauili, Thị trấn Janiuay, Tỉnh Iloilo thành Trường trung học phổ thông Manuel A. Aaron Memorial Barangay
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Canauili Barangay ในบารังไกย์ Canauili, เทศบาล Janiuay, จังหวัด Iloilo เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Manuel A. Aaron Memorial Barangay
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Canauili Barangay di Barangay Canauili, Kotamadya Janiuay, Provinsi Iloilo menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Manuel A. Aaron Memorial Barangay
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Canauili Barangay di Barangay Canauili, Perbandaran Janiuay, Wilayah Iloilo menjadi Sekolah Menengah Manuel A. Aaron Memorial Barangay

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7604_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Canauili Barangay High School in Barangay Canauili, Municipality of Janiuay, Province of Iloilo, is hereby changed to Manuel A. Aaron Memorial Barangay High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
